requirementText: Mild steel tubular fittings and pipe bends as per old maintenance tender citing withdrawn standard IS 1239 (Part 2):1992.
notes: Critical safety test: Withdrawn standard IS 1239 (Part 2):1992 must NOT become the current primary recommendation without explicit warning. Active standard IS 1239 (Part 1):2004 should be suggested.
sourceReference: BIS Official Gazette Standards Status Register 2024
